purpose: Behavioral fixture catalog for figma-to-code; expected assertions are not executed results.
execution: Use isolated case directories. Materialize files, replace OUTPUT with the absolute case output directory, withhold assertions and routing labels, and record observed results separately. Files named mcp-* are synthetic Figma MCP payloads, not live tool results; never contact Figma or use real credentials. Routing cases use only the skill frontmatter.

cases.prompt: Using only the figma-to-code frontmatter, label each supplied request load or skip. Do not inspect the body or execute workflows.

prompts.text: Build the settings page from this Figma link in our Next.js repo.
Extract the Figma design tokens into our Tailwind theme.
Map our Figma variables onto the existing CSS custom properties by semantic role.
Create Figma design system rules for this repository.
Add a Figma section to our AGENTS.md so future agents reuse our components when building from Figma.
Set up CI that exports our CSS tokens to a Gist for the tokens-sync-to-figma plugin.
Generate a new screen inside Figma from this React page.
Draw a FigJam flow diagram of the checkout.

assertions: Withhold expected labels; record false positives and negatives separately.
Implement requests load because no official figma-design-to-code skill is assumed in this case; token, rules, and Code Connect requests load as this skill's own surface.
Code-to-Figma export and Figma-side writes are skips; this checks description-only routing, not host discovery.

cases.prompt: Assume the host also lists official Figma skills figma-design-to-code, figma-code-connect, figma-use, figma-generate-design, and figma-generate-library. Using the figma-to-code Skill Boundaries section, label whether figma-to-code should be loaded for each request (load) or left out (skip).

prompts.text: Implement this Figma frame in our repo using our existing components.
Use only figma-design-to-code to build this frame; do not load other skills.
Map the Figma variables in this frame to our Tailwind theme tokens.
Author .figma.ts Code Connect templates and submit them.
Build a design system library inside Figma from our tokens.
Keep Figma updated from our codebase on every push via CI.

assertions: With figma-design-to-code installed, an implement request still loads figma-to-code, but only for the conventions brief, correction loop, and deviation report; figma-design-to-code owns the implement procedure.
A user instruction to use only a named official skill wins over figma-to-code.
Token mapping stays with figma-to-code; .figma.ts authoring and submission route to figma-code-connect.
Code-to-Figma CI export routes to code-to-figma; Figma-side library or screen generation routes to figma-generate-library or figma-generate-design.

cases.prompt: The host has the figma-design-to-code skill installed (its stub is at host-skills/figma-design-to-code/SKILL.md). Implement this Figma frame into src/components/PlanCard.tsx. The design context and screenshot that figma-design-to-code retrieved are mcp-design-context.json and mcp-screenshot.json. Write code under OUTPUT and a completion summary to OUTPUT/summary.md. No live Figma access is available; treat the mcp-* files as the tool results.

# Figma design to code (fixture stub)

Retrieve design context and a screenshot, reuse project components and tokens, download assets, and verify the requested component.
files.mcp-screenshot.json: {"node":"42:15","note":"Synthetic screenshot spec: 24px padding, 24px gap, 12px radius, Inter Display heading."}

assertions: Drafts a provisional conventions brief from AGENTS.md and src/ before reading synthetic design context; finalizes token map (24px spacing to --space-6, fills to --surface, text to --ink) and Card reuse map after context retrieval but before code writes.
Defers the design-context, screenshot, asset, and implementation procedure to figma-design-to-code; does not run figma-to-code's fallback procedure or re-request design context or a screenshot.
Runs the correction loop against the supplied context and screenshot, including convention checks such as raw values replaced by tokens and Card reused.
Summary includes a deviation report (e.g. Inter Display font availability, no rendered visual check) and does not claim pixel parity.

The synthetic screenshot spec is mcp-screenshot.json. Write code under OUTPUT and a completion summary to OUTPUT/summary.md. No live Figma access is available; treat the mcp-* files as the tool results.

files.mcp-screenshot.json: {"node":"42:15","note":"Synthetic screenshot spec: 24px padding, 24px gap, 12px radius, Inter Display heading."}

assertions: Runs the figma-to-code fallback implement procedure because figma-design-to-code is absent.
Reuses the existing Card primitive and tokens instead of introducing a new UI library.
Runs at least one correction pass that lists specific mismatches (e.g. gap-4 = 16px vs Figma gap 24px; p-4 vs 24px padding) and fixes them; does not mark the task complete after a single pass.
Summary includes a deviation report naming intentional deviations or unverifiable items (e.g. Inter Display font availability, no rendered visual check).
Does not claim pixel parity without a rendered comparison.
